name: adx_trend_strength_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, large institutional TWAP algorithms executing directional orders over a 5-minute window create sustained directional pressure visible as ADX(60) rising through 25 — the cumulative high-low ranges skew consistently in one direction as the algorithm absorbs opposing liquidity. The +DI/-DI spread widening above 8 confirms the imbalance is directional rather than choppy two-sided volatility. At 5-second resolution, we enter when ADX is STILL RISING through the 25 level, meaning the institutional order is only partially filled and the next 30-90 seconds will see continued directional pressure before the order completes. The VWAP filter ensures we trade with the session flow, not against accumulated directional drift.

indicators.name: ADX_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute ADX as trend context filter. Original used 14-bar on 1-min (14 minutes). We compress to 5 minutes because our hold is 30-90s — we need a trend that formed recently enough that institutional order flow is still active. 14-min context is too stale for a 90s hold. The 5-min window (60 bars) captures trends that started within the last 5 minutes, ensuring the driving order is still partially unfilled.

indicators.name: plus_DI_60
indicators.purpose: Positive directional indicator on same 5-min window as ADX. Measures upward directional movement fraction. Same period as ADX for consistency.

indicators.name: minus_DI_60
indicators.purpose: Negative directional indicator. DI spread (+DI - -DI) > 8 confirms genuinely directional bias rather than noise; threshold of 8 instead of original's 10 accounts for NIFTY's smoother index-level moves vs individual stocks.

indicators.name: VWAP
indicators.formula: cumulative sum(price * volume) / cumulative sum(volume) from 09:15 IST
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP — no scaling needed, cumulative measure. Confirms that the ADX-driven move aligns with session directional flow. Trend entries above VWAP (CE) or below VWAP (PE) have higher continuation probability as they align with VWAP-benchmarked institutional positioning.

conditions: ADX(60)[t] > ADX(60)[t-1] (ADX still rising — institutional order still active)
close > VWAP — price above session benchmark, aligns with institutional accumulation
buy_ce.confirmation: All four conditions must be true simultaneously on the same 5-second bar

conditions: close < VWAP — price below session benchmark, aligns with institutional distribution
buy_pe.confirmation: All four conditions must be true simultaneously

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts = ~8 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5. If a genuine 5-min institutional trend stalls by 8 spot pts within 90s, the directional order has either completed or reversed — thesis is invalidated. For a 5-min trend context, 8 spot pt adverse move in 90s is the failure threshold.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts = ~14 NIFTY spot pts. A fresh 5-min institutional trend at ADX 25-35 typically extends 20-30 spot pts from the entry bar; capturing 14 pts (50-70% of the first leg) within 90s is conservative and achievable. 1:1.75 risk-reward at 4 stop.

filters.vix_filter: none — ADX-based trend entries work across VIX regimes on NIFTY; VIX regime determines trend magnitude, not direction
filters.time_filter: no entries before 09:25 (ADX needs 120-bar warmup = 10 min) or after 15:20
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY index volume is noisy at 5s; ADX intrinsically captures directional volume via high-low range
filters.trend_filter: DI spread > 8 IS the trend filter; avoids choppy consolidation periods when DI lines converge

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — ADX > 25 on NIFTY is not frequent (2-4 genuine trend periods per day), limiting trade count but improving signal quality

adaptation_notes: Original strategy traded ADX cross on NIFTY200 individual stocks with 20-60 min holds. Conversion: (1) ADX period compressed from 14-bar/1-min (14 min) to 60-bar/5s (5 min) — hold time compression from 20-60 min to 30-90s requires a proportionally shorter trend detection window. (2) DI spread threshold relaxed from 10 to 8 — NIFTY index is smoother than individual stocks, DI lines are less volatile. (3) Added ADX-still-rising condition (ADX[t] > ADX[t-1]) as entry trigger — this detects the NASCENT trend (institutional order ongoing) rather than mature trend. (4) Removed volume filter — NIFTY volume at 5s is too noisy; ADX already captures directional range pressure. (5) Session start delayed to 09:25 for ADX warmup.
weaknesses: ADX(60) on 5-second NIFTY bars is inherently smoother and slower than individual stock ADX — fewer trend transitions per day
NIFTY index rarely exceeds ADX 35+ at 5-min resolution; most signals cluster near the 25 threshold where false positives are more frequent
Correlated signals: when NIFTY trends, multiple consecutive bars will all fire — need trade limiter to prevent over-entry
